query: Create a Jira ticket for adding a keyboard-visible focus state to the primary button in facilitron-ui. The Figma source is https://figma.com/file/button-focus and Maya signs off Friday.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as engineering work for facilitron-ui and uses the UI summary prefix
Fetches or otherwise grounds the named Figma source before drafting context details
Collects the remaining rubric fields, including concrete affected paths and at least two checkable acceptance criteria
Adds an optional one-sentence Intent marker only if the supplied source evidence establishes the desired user or system outcome
Shows a machine-header ticket draft and its rubric verdict before creating the Jira ticket
Creates only after approval, using md-to-adf and acli, then verifies the stored ticket and assignee
